ideas.pitch: An automated cryptographic puzzle solver and flag extractor designed specifically for CTF cryptography categories, leveraging custom lattice and modular arithmetic reduction routines.
ideas.title: CryptoFlag Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the CTF's Cryptography category by offering high performance in solving flawed RSA implementations and weak curves faster than manual scripting.

ideas.pitch: A reverse engineering assistant that ingests compiled binaries, decompiles bytecode via Ghidra headless integration, and uses local LLMs to suggest descriptive variable names and flag locations.
ideas.problem_statement: NEXPLOIT CTF — Reverse Engineering challenge category
ideas.title: Deobfuscate-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy engineering like automated binary analysis pipelines, matching the pattern of genuinely hard engineering seen in top hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An advanced digital forensics pipeline that performs automated entropy analysis, file-carving, and hidden bitstream extraction across corrupted disk images and media files.
ideas.problem_statement: NEXPLOIT CTF — Digital Forensics challenge category
ideas.title: StegTrail Forensics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Digital Forensics track directly by automating tedious multi-step hex and metadata inspection tasks that usually cost teams precious hours during timed CTFs.

ideas.pitch: A real-time web exploitation interceptor and sandbox that detects SQLi, XSS, and SSRF anomalies using AST-based payload parsing rather than brittle regex signatures.
ideas.problem_statement: NEXPLOIT CTF — Web Exploitation challenge category
ideas.title: PayloadShield WAF
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts a defense-in-depth approach inspired by winning security agents, proving deep technical competence in application security and web vulnerability analysis.

ideas.pitch: A collaborative graph visualization tool for logical problem-solving and multi-stage CTF challenges that maps dependency trees, shared clues, and team hypotheses in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: NEXPLOIT CTF — Logical Problem-Solving challenge category
ideas.title: LogicGraph CTF Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the friction of team coordination during fast-paced online CTF events, providing a clear workflow advantage that impresses judges looking for practical utility.
